def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2D")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon) or logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if n_candidates == 0 or future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("All inputs must be finite")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("All input log probabilities must be <= 0")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    # Step T01: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Step T02: Compute weighted future-token loss for each condition
    L_plus = -np.sum(weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Step T03: Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Step T04 + T05: Compute margin and keep decision, preserve order
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
